verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents an approval gate before an agent starts work ('Nothing runs until a person approves a contract... an agent is about to change your repository') and a mobile approvals list for big decisions, but this is approval of a task/contract before execution, not a diff review of the agent's actual code changes prior to PR creation — the agent opens the pull request directly from the checkout for review via normal GitHub flow. missing for 10: explicit in-product diff/code review UI shown before a PR is opened, and independent/hands-on confirmation that this gate functions as a diff-review-and-approve step rather than a pre-work task approval.
